Karak Wraith was introduced during the Operation: Tubemen of Regor event, where players would need to complete a minimum of four regional battles in favor of one side more than the other, and Alad V was the victor of the conflict. Alad V had won the conflict in the PC and XB1 versions of the game, but not in the PS4. The weapon was fully built and came with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst. The blueprint and parts were formerly a reward from the First and Third Seasons of Sorties; they can now be found as an Invasion reward. All components can be traded, although players must have a Mastery Rank of at least 7 to acquire the blueprint.

All parts can be traded between players.

entries.original: Inaros's main and component blueprints are obtained from the Sands of Inaros quest. The quest blueprint is tradeable from another player, or purchasable from Baro Ki'Teer for + 25,000 크레딧. Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris; 25,000 평판 for component blueprints and 50,000 평판 for main blueprint. Alternatively, upon completion of The Duviri Paradox, Inaros's main and component blueprints can be earned from The Circuit. By selecting him on the rotating week he is available, players can earn his blueprints after reaching Tier 2 (Neuroptics), 5 (Chassis), 8 (Systems), and 10 (Main) rewards.

Sentient Cores are dropped from various Sentient enemies. They appear as white and blue orbs that float above the ground, lit up by a blue aura that makes them more visible, and marked with HUD icons much like Ayatan Stars. On the Plains of Eidolon, 온전한 센티언트 코어 are dropped by while 우수한 센티언트 코어 are dropped by destroying the Synovia joints of the Eidolons. They may also drop Exceptional Sentient Cores when facing against them while on Lua, or a Murex in Veil Proxima. entries.original: The weapon blueprint is given to the player at the end of the Erra quest. Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 100,000 평판. The Shedu's components are rare drops from Symbilysts found in Sentient Anomalies that appear in the Veil Proxima during Empyrean missions. The ship occupies one random node for 30 minutes, indicated by a red flashing Sentient symbol, then rotates to a different node. Symbilysts were also found in Operation: Scarlet Spear and Operation: Orphix Venom. The parts can be traded between players. Symbilysts also spawn in Archon Hunts in higher numbers per mission, especially in Defense and Interception missions.

Alternatively they can be purchased from Otak in the Necralisk, Deimos with 벨릭 결정체 조각 and 라니아 결정체 조각, awarded from Mirror Defense in quantities of 5 (7 on The Steel Path) cycling between the two from collecting Citrine's Remnants, and in quantities of 10 (15 on The Steel Path) per rotation; each component requires 250 Belric and 150 Rania, while the blueprint requires 500 Belric and 300 Rania, totaling to 1,250 Belric and 750 Rania Crystal Fragments. All components can be traded between players, but not the blueprint.

entries.original: 쿠바 is a special resource that can be collected with the help of Operator Void abilities from Kuva Siphons, which appear on planets near the ever-moving Kuva Fortress. In addition to its use as a crafting material, Kuva is used to cycle Riven Mods. Due to the circumstances through which the Kuva Fortress itself is discovered, accessing Kuva Siphon and Kuva Flood missions is only possible after completing The War Within quest. Kuva Siphon Missions now require players to be Mastery Rank 5. These missions can be found on nodes marked with a 쿠바 symbol, which appear on planets currently being orbited by the Kuva Fortress. __TOC__

entries.original: Athodai was acquired by watching TennoCon 2020 on [https://twitch.tv/warframe WARFRAME's Twitch] with a [https://www.warframe.com/twitch/link Twitch-linked account] for 30 consecutive minutes, between 12:30 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. ET, on August 1st, 2020. This resulted in some players receiving two Athodai. Athodai's blueprint and components are now available in Venus Proxima Abandoned Derelict Caches in Empyrean missions. All parts can be traded between players.

They can be converted into 2,500 Focus for any school, and are used in the crafting of 파라세시스. 10, 20, and 30 Eidolon Shards are required as a sacrifice for Rank 3 (Adherent), Rank 4 (Instrument), and Rank 5 (Architect) of 퀼, respectively. Grendel's component blueprints are awarded by completing certain missions on Europa using Locators, which can be purchased from the Arbitration Honors vendor found in any Relay for 25 바이터스 에센스 each. Purchasing a Locator unlocks the unique mission associated with it. These missions have level 25-30 enemies, but place heavy restrictions on the player: * No Gear * No unique weapon traits (Syndicate Weapons keep their Syndicate Radial Effects) * Kuva, Tenet, and Coda weapons will not have their elemental damage bonus * Incarnon weapons will not transform and evolution bonuses will not apply * Operators cannot be used, and any Focus abilities are disabled * Mods and Arcanes are disabled, but Augments will still function * Helminth Invigorations are disabled. * No Archon Shards Each mission is guaranteed to award the associated Grendel component blueprint if successfully completed, despite the Locator's flavor text stating sites "likely" to contain blueprints. The Locators and their associated unlocks are as follows: *The 그렌델 뉴로옵틱스

The main blueprint is offered as a rank up reward, but Necraloid sells additional main blueprints for 8,000 평판. Additionally requires Rank 2 - Visitor with 오스트론 in order to acquire 페르스틸 얼로이 required in its construction. The Damaged Necramech Weapon parts are acquired from Normal and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounty rewards. The Damaged Necramech Weapon parts and fully built Cortege components can be traded between players. Trading for fully built components will bypass the need for Ostron's Fersteel Alloy.

entries.original: Intact= |-|Exceptional= |-|Flawless= Sentient Cores are Sentient objects that can be traded in for Standing with 퀼 in Cetus. They are also used to craft 레버넌트 and his 판타즈마, and 버딜락. Sentient Cores are dropped from various Sentient enemies. They appear as white and blue orbs that float above the ground, lit up by a blue aura that makes them more visible, and marked with HUD icons much like Ayatan Stars. On the Plains of Eidolon, 온전한 센티언트 코어 are dropped by while 우수한 센티언트 코어 are dropped by destroying the Synovia joints of the Eidolons. A 완벽한 센티언트 코어 is dropped upon successfully capturing (not defeating) an Eidolon through having them fully tethered by allied ; both the 아이돌론 조각 and the Flawless Sentient Cores will be dropped by the Lures upon self-destruction, not by the Eidolon themself. , and can also drop Intact Sentient Cores. They may also drop Exceptional Sentient Cores when facing against them while on Lua, or a Murex in Veil Proxima. The Exceptional Sentient Core Conversion, a reusable Blueprint to upgrade Intact Cores to Exceptional ones, is available as an Offering from The Quil

entries.original: The Cortege main blueprint can be acquired by reaching Rank 3 - Clearance: Odima with the 네크랄로이드. The main blueprint is offered as a rank up reward, but Necraloid sells additional main blueprints for 8,000 평판. Components are crafted from blueprints that can be acquired for 4,000 평판 each after reaching Rank 2 - Clearance: Modus with the syndicate. Once crafted, it comes with a pre-installed Gravimag. Additionally requires Rank 2 - Visitor with 오스트론 in order to acquire 페르스틸 얼로이 required in its construction. The Damaged Necramech Weapon parts are acquired from Normal and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounty rewards. The Damaged Necramech Weapon parts and fully built Cortege components can be traded between players. Trading for fully built components will bypass the need for Ostron's Fersteel Alloy.

entries.original: 포르마 are items most commonly used as a supercharger to add, remove, or alter the Polarity of a Mod slot on equipment such as Warframes, Archwings, weapons, or Companions. This process is called Polarization and allows mod capacity to be used more efficiently. Forma do however have additional uses. Their second most notable use is as a component in the creation of certain items, including being used in weapon blueprints, the creation of the 엑실러스 워프레임 어댑터 and other supercharger equipment, and adding Tiles to a Clan Dojo. Finally, Forma may be sacrificed to rise in Syndicate ranks.
